title: Database Foundation
description: Establishes the global DatabaseModule, Kysely configuration, all table types, and a single migration that creates the complete database schema.
acceptance_criteria: DatabaseModule is decorated with @Global() and exports DatabaseService
DatabaseService extends Kysely<Database> and connects using process.env.DATABASE_URL
types.ts exports a Database interface containing: organizations, users, projects, tasks, comments, attachments, notifications, audit_logs tables
Every table interface includes tenant_id: string (including organizations for consistency)
Generated<> is used ONLY on id, created_at, updated_at, is_active, and read columns
users.role is typed as 'Admin' | 'ProjectManager' | 'Member'
projects.status is typed as 'Active' | 'Archived'
tasks.status is typed as 'ToDo' | 'InProgress' | 'Completed'
001_initial.ts creates ALL tables with correct columns, PKs, FKs, CHECK constraints, UNIQUE constraints, ON DELETE CASCADE rules, and indexes exactly as specified
projects has UNIQUE (tenant_id, name)
users.email is UNIQUE globally
All foreign keys reference correct parent tables with ON DELETE CASCADE where required
migrate.ts runs all pending migrations on application bootstrap
app.module.ts imports DatabaseModule

title: Authentication Module
description: Implements JWT authentication, registration, login, refresh token, global guard, and role-based authorization decorators.
acceptance_criteria: AuthModule imports JwtModule and registers APP_GUARD for JwtAuthGuard and RolesGuard
POST /api/auth/register is decorated with @Public() and accepts email, password, first_name, last_name only
RegisterDto validates email with @IsEmail(), password with @MinLength(8), first_name and last_name with @IsString(), @MinLength(1), @MaxLength(100)
register endpoint NEVER accepts role from body and hardcodes role to 'Member'
register creates a new organization and user with tenant_id equal to organization.id
Password is hashed using bcrypt with 12 rounds
Returns 201 with { id, email, first_name, last_name, role: 'Member', tenant_id }
POST /api/auth/login is decorated with @Public() and returns { access_token, refresh_token, user }
Login returns 401 UnauthorizedException if credentials invalid
POST /api/auth/refresh is decorated with @Public() and returns new { access_token } when valid refresh token provided
GET /api/auth/me returns authenticated user object
JWT payload contains sub, email, role, tenant_id
jwt.strategy validate() returns { id, email, role, tenant_id } assigned to req.user
Controllers have NO @UseGuards() decorator
AuthModule is added to app.module.ts imports

title: Organizations Module
description: Allows creation of a new organization with its first Admin user and immediately returns an access token.
acceptance_criteria: POST /api/organizations is decorated with @Public()
CreateOrganizationDto has name: @IsString() @MinLength(1) @MaxLength(255), email: @IsEmail(), password: @MinLength(8), first_name and last_name with same validation as register
Endpoint creates organization and first user with role 'Admin'
Email must be globally unique or throw ConflictException
Password hashed with bcrypt 12 rounds
Returns 201 with { access_token, refresh_token, user } same shape as login response
Controllers have NO @UseGuards() decorator
OrganizationsModule is added to app.module.ts imports

title: Users Module
description: Implements tenant-scoped user listing and role management with strict Admin-only access.
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/users requires @Roles('Admin')
GET /api/users supports ?page and ?limit with default page=1, limit=20, max=100
GET /api/users returns { data: User[], meta: { total, page, limit, totalPages } }
GET /api/users queries always include .where('tenant_id', '=', req.user.tenant_id)
PATCH /api/users/:id/role requires @Roles('Admin')
UpdateUserRoleDto has role: @IsIn(['Admin','ProjectManager','Member'])
Cannot change own role or throw ForbiddenException
Must verify target user belongs to same tenant or throw NotFoundException
PATCH returns updated user object
Controllers have NO @UseGuards() decorator
UsersModule is added to app.module.ts imports

title: Projects Module
description: Provides CRUD operations for tenant-scoped projects with role-based access control.
acceptance_criteria: POST /api/projects requires @Roles('Admin','ProjectManager')
CreateProjectDto has name: @IsString() @MaxLength(200), description: @IsOptional() @IsString() @MaxLength(1000)
Project name must be unique per tenant or throw ConflictException
All inserts include tenant_id from req.user.tenant_id
GET /api/projects is authenticated and paginated
GET /api/projects filters using .where('tenant_id', '=', req.user.tenant_id)
PATCH /api/projects/:id requires @Roles('Admin','ProjectManager')
UpdateProjectDto allows optional name, description, status with @IsIn(['Active','Archived'])
Cannot modify Archived project except Admin changing status
DELETE /api/projects/:id requires @Roles('Admin') and returns 204
All queries include tenant filter
Controllers have NO @UseGuards() decorator
ProjectsModule is added to app.module.ts imports

title: Tasks Module
description: Implements tenant-isolated task management with ownership and role-based rules.
acceptance_criteria: POST /api/tasks requires @Roles('Admin','ProjectManager','Member')
CreateTaskDto has project_id: @IsUUID(), title: @IsString() @MaxLength(200), description: @IsOptional() @IsString(), assignee_id: @IsUUID()
Project and assignee must belong to same tenant as req.user or throw NotFoundException
Default status is 'ToDo'
GET /api/tasks supports ?page, ?limit, ?project_id and is paginated
All queries include .where('tenant_id', '=', req.user.tenant_id)
If role is 'Member', GET /api/tasks must filter .where('assignee_id', '=', req.user.id)
PATCH /api/tasks/:id requires @Roles('Admin','ProjectManager','Member')
Members can only update tasks where task.assignee_id === req.user.id or throw ForbiddenException
UpdateTaskDto allows optional title, description, status @IsIn(['ToDo','InProgress','Completed']), assignee_id
DELETE /api/tasks/:id requires @Roles('Admin','ProjectManager') and returns 204
Controllers have NO @UseGuards() decorator
TasksModule is added to app.module.ts imports

title: Comments and Attachments Module
description: Adds task-level comments and attachments with strict tenant and ownership enforcement.
acceptance_criteria: POST /api/comments requires authenticated user
CreateCommentDto has task_id: @IsUUID(), content: @IsString() @MinLength(1)
Comment insert includes tenant_id from req.user
DELETE /api/comments/:id only allowed if comment.user_id === req.user.id else throw ForbiddenException
POST /api/attachments requires authenticated user
CreateAttachmentDto has task_id: @IsUUID(), file_name: @IsString(), file_url: @IsString()
All queries filter using .where('tenant_id', '=', req.user.tenant_id)
GET /api/tasks/:taskId/comments is paginated and tenant filtered
Controllers have NO @UseGuards() decorator
CollaborationModule is added to app.module.ts imports

title: Dashboard and Notifications Module
description: Provides tenant-scoped dashboard metrics and user notifications with read tracking.
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/dashboard/summary returns { totalProjects, totalTasks, completedTasks, activeUsers } scoped by tenant
All dashboard queries include tenant filter
GET /api/notifications is paginated and returns { data, meta }
Notifications filtered by tenant_id and user_id = req.user.id
PATCH /api/notifications/:id/read sets read=true only if notification.user_id === req.user.id
Controllers have NO @UseGuards() decorator
DashboardModule and NotificationsModule are added to app.module.ts imports

title: Audit Logs Module
description: Implements tenant-scoped audit logging and retrieval for security and traceability.
acceptance_criteria: AuditService exposes method logAction(userId: string, tenantId: string, action: string, entity: string, entity_id: string)
GET /api/audit-logs requires @Roles('Admin')
GET /api/audit-logs is paginated and filters using .where('tenant_id', '=', req.user.tenant_id)
Response shape is { data: AuditLog[], meta: { total, page, limit, totalPages } }
Controllers have NO @UseGuards() decorator
AuditModule is added to app.module.ts imports
